title: Wren and the Current
author: Ines Winterbourne
blurb: Jonah Amberdale, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
